item.title: IND vs SA [WATCH]: Virat Kohli’s 52nd ODI century celebrations interrupted after a fan slips past security and bows at his feet in Ranchi
item.description: Virat Kohli’s hundred moment disrupted when a fan breaks security and kneels at his feet during IND vs SA Ranchi ODI game. Kohli produced a vintage masterclass in the 1st ODI against South Africa in Ranchi, lighting up the stadium with a majestic century that showcased touch, timing and temperament.

item.title: IND vs SA [WATCH]: Rohit Sharma’s wholesome reaction steals the spotlight after Virat Kohli’s brilliant Ranchi century in 1st ODI
item.description: Rohit Sharma’s emotional reaction to Virat Kohli’s 52nd ODI century in Ranchi turned into one of the most cherished highlights of the game. India’s total of 349/8 has placed them firmly ahead in the first ODI in Ranchi against South Africa.

item.title: IND vs SA [WATCH]: Harshit Rana gives an aggressive send off to Dewald Brevis after dismissing him during Ranchi ODI
item.description: Harshit Rana gave a fiery send off to Dewald Brevis during the IND vs SA clash in Ranchi ODI. Brevis scored 37 off 28 balls with the help of 2 fours and 3 sixes.

item.title: Fans celebrate as Virat Kohli and bowlers help India edge past South Africa by 17 runs in a thrilling Ranchi ODI clash
item.description: India won the first ODI game of three-match series in Ranchi by 17 runs against South Africa. Virat Kohli brought up his 83rd international century, scoring 135 off 120 balls.

item.title: IND vs SA: Virat Kohli shuts down Test retirement U-turn talk with clear statement
item.description: Virat Kohli responded to buzz around his Test retirement reversal. Kohli played a match-winning knock in the first ODI against South Africa at Ranchi.

item.title: HH-W vs MS-W, WBBL|11 Match Prediction: Who will win today’s game between Hobart Hurricanes and Melbourne Stars?
item.description: Hobart Hurricanes will face on Melbourne Stars in Match 32 of WBBL 2025. The encounter is scheduled to take place at Bellerive Oval, Hobart on Monday.

item.title: KKR owner Shah Rukh Khan pens a touching tribute to Andre Russell post his IPL retirement
item.description: Shah Rukh Khan penned an emotional message for Andre Russell after he announced his IPL retirement. Russel will continue playing other T20 leagues.​

item.title: IND vs SA [WATCH]: Virat Kohli’s passionate celebration lights up Ranchi after Kuldeep Yadav’s crucial wicket during 1st ODI
item.description: Virat Kohli channeled his emotions as Kuldeep Yadav strikes during India's ODI clash in Ranchi. India triumphed over South Africa by 17 runs at the JSCA International Stadium Complex in Ranchi.

item.title: WATCH: Rohit Sharma and Gautam Gambhir engage in an animated discussion after India’s 1st ODI win against South Africa
item.description: Rohit Sharma and Gautam Gambhir's intense post-match dressing room chat after India's victory went viral. Virat Kohli's explosive 135 and Rohit's steady 57 propelled India to a thrilling 17-run win over South Africa.
